title: Feature Request: Allow user to choose if Nightscout upload uses noise smoothed or unprocessed data
symptom: xDrip uploads to Nightscout always use unprocessed data, while xDrip displays data smoothed for noise, causing a mismatch for users who rely on Nightscout for data display.
cause: The uploads currently always use unprocessed data, while xDrip displays data smoothed for noise.
fix: A toggle was added in the REST-API settings under Cloud Upload -> Rest API -> Send Display Glucose, allowing the user to choose whether to upload display (smoothed) glucose or unprocessed data. The default behavior was initially set to off, but the user suggested making it default to enabled.
settings_changed: Send Display Glucose → enabled (toggle flipped on)
evidence_quote: Enable it within the REST-API settings in xDrip.
